safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies any chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations, headaches, or visual symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated ROS includes no SOB/palpitations/headache/vision changes, but does not include denial of chest pain.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the documented denial of chest pain slightly reduces completeness of the ROS and may prompt unnecessary additional questioning or testing, but it is unlikely to change management in this presentation of lower abdominal pain without cardiopulmonary symptoms.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Advising follow-up “in a few days” instead of 24–48 hours can delay reassessment of potentially serious causes of lower abdominal pain and possible hematuria (e.g., evolving pyelonephritis, appendicitis, or pregnancy-related complications), increasing the risk of progression before review.
